<!-- Reference points and short-term projections. Reads params$model_dir -->

## Reference points

```{r}
#| label: gadget-rp-setup
#| include: false
model_dir <- here::here(params$model_dir)
rp_file <- file.path(model_dir, "long_term_projections/reference_points.rda")
has_rp <- file.exists(rp_file)
if (has_rp) load(rp_file)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gadget-refpoints
#| tbl-cap: "Reference points on the model's scale."
#| eval: !expr has_rp
ref_points |> knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```
